raw_text: update docs audit drit skill to always present the full list of drift+fix per item and make sure it is in simple writing so its easy to understand what the drift is and what the fix should be

expectation: Every user-facing docs-drift report lists every finding with a plain Drift and Fix

protection.accepted_example: A1 — Platform conflict. Drift: Architecture promises Debian gateway metrics, but the platform matrix allows only Ubuntu. Fix: Record Ubuntu-only intent and remove Debian support promises.
